full_brief:
Topics: Members should create discussion posts with a title and opening body. Other members should reply to those posts. A reply may itself have replies. Discussions belong to a club. Members must not see private discussions in clubs they do not belong to. Inspect actual existing fields before creating a new record type.

Notifications: Members should subscribe to a discussion and get an email when someone replies. Members can unsubscribe. Sending a message must respect current club membership and content access. A module that only stores comments is not a notification delivery system.
scope: Selected judgments from a recorded development run, before later architect refinements. Brief and labels shortened in the animation. These are per-requirement probabilities for partial fit, not coverage percentages or a ranking across requirements. No combination is verified.
